svg.title: The second equality extends from compact words through the same compact test cutoffs, Schwartz- word continuity and cyclic density. Inverse unitary recovery gives exactly the source’s rank-one zero-energy conclusion and its heat-limit input to weak irreducibility. On a complex slice retain the original indexing filter F, connected domain U, local boundedness balls and accumulation set. Scalar word recovery gives F Z a (z) = Fa(z) and fZ(z) = f(z) at every interior point. It therefore preserves the local tail sets and Cauchy bounds with exactly their stated ball dependence.
